notes.title: Swordia Updates!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Swordians,[/p][p]It's been awhile since our last publically announced update but we have been hard at work! Some of the changes are:[/p][p]- Tons of bug fixes[/p][p]- Tons of typo corrections[/p][p]- Moved the hotbar to bottom center of the screen[/p][p]- Added sound effects to portals[/p][p]- Added a brand new minigame called Crab Rave.. A wave based crab survival minigame.[/p][p]- You will no longer drop loot/items UNLESS you're in PVP. (This is a big change requested by many community members over time)[/p][p]- PVP can only be enacted in specified PVP zones which are clearly marked on the map.[/p][p]- Update store page on Steam
- Server owners can now customize the entire game including UI to make their own games (This can also make non-mmo games too!)
- Revamp server master system to be less confusing
- Optimize server master system (Issues with master server bugging out fixed!)
- Added redundancy to all our official worlds and master server! (Less downtime / Hopefully none) 
- Lots of QOL updates requested by the community have been added such as options for "Sticky Targeting & Auto-turn to target"![/p][p]- Begin marketing campaigns for Swordia[/p]

notes.title: Swordia Major Update
notes.notes:
A MAJOR content patch has been pushed to Swordia. Due to the amount of bugs in the initial alpha state... I unfortunately had to wipe progress in the database. Here is a list of new features and changes:

New areas to explore along with new monsters and other interactable content.
Diagonal movement systems
Lag fixes (The game stutters no more!)
Fishing has been added, though many new fishing improvements are underway
Lots of rebalancing of existing content
Lots of patches to exploits that previously existed
And so much more!

The price of Swordia has been updated from $4.99 to $9.99 as we near closer to full release.

notes.title: Swordia Updates
notes.notes:
Hello Swordians! 🌟
We’re thrilled to bring you an exciting list of game updates that are pushing Swordia to new heights! This latest patch includes major engine overhauls and improvements that will enhance your gameplay experience and bring even more flexibility and fun to Swordia. Here’s what’s new:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🚀 Engine Overhauls & Performance Improvements
New Animation Systems: Smooth and dynamic animations to enhance the visual experience.
New Projectile Systems: Experience improved accuracy and functionality in all projectile mechanics.
Fixes to Projectile Systems: All known bugs have been squashed for seamless gameplay.
Stuttering/Lag Fixes: Say goodbye to lag—gameplay is now more fluid and responsive.
Multi-threading Upgrades: Game processes are now as multi-threaded as safely possible, which significantly boosts performance and speeds up the game!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
📂 User Content System Revamp
Full System Overhaul: Everything—including UI and more—can now be overridden by the user content system! 🎨
Content Download Improvements: Content now caches per server, so you only download once unless updates are needed.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

✨ Gameplay Enhancements
Diagonal Movement: Move in style! Diagonal movement has been added for smoother navigation.
Major Bug Fixes: Tons of engine-related bugs have been fixed, making Swordia even more stable.
Save Password Fixes - Fixes to the save password functionality. It now just works.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

💻 Platform & Server Customization
Windows 10/11 Compatibility: Launching issues are now resolved, so the game will always run as expected.
New Server Customization Options: Server hosters, rejoice! You now have additional options to tailor your servers to your liking.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
These updates represent our ongoing commitment to making Swordia the best it can be for our amazing community. Thank you for your continued support, feedback, and passion—it drives us to keep improving and growing this world we share.
As always, we’d love to hear what you think! Jump into the discussion and let us know your thoughts, or share your favorite changes from this update.
Happy adventuring, Swordians! 🗡️🌍

notes.title: User-Made Content Now Available!
notes.notes: We have been working hard to allow server owners to completely edit the game as they see fit AND even give the possibility to make their own entire game. We now allow for user based content which the server owner can add their own game assets to the game safely. Now server owners have complete control over the content they stream on their server.

notes.title: Recoded Launcher & Game File
notes.notes: The game launcher and  game files have been updated to be fully compatible with Windows 10 and 11.

notes.title: Windows 11 & 10 Fixes
notes.notes: When we quickly released the Windows 11 crash bug fix we noticed that due to Steam permissions the game could no longer write to the game folder causing the game not to load. This has been fixed in this build. We apologize to our community for the inconvenience this might have caused.

notes.title: Fixed Download Servers & Launcher Install Fixes
notes.notes: We have migrated our download servers to much faster services. We also fixed the launcher's uninstall processes to make reinstalling the game a breeze!

notes.title: Confirmation Email Fixes & Launcher Crash Fixes
notes.notes: We have received a couple reports from Windows 11 users where the launcher was not launching the game. This was due to a slight misconfiguration in our anti-cheat and this has been fixed as of the latest patch.  We are a very small studio so we apologize for the inconvenience it may have caused. We have also fixed the confirmation email system to a now verified email server instead of using a relay server.... This ensures all emails will arrive as they should. Thank you for your patience.
